review_kind: Complete Templates & Workflows and Data Extraction & Transformation install-pointer cluster (443 exact pinned packages), individual 10-dimension static candidate reviews; NOT governed review, security scan or behavioral validation
review_method: Parallel read-only reviewers each assigned disjoint exact package identities with one shared rubric brief; every SKILL.md and package file read in full at the exact pin; one integration owner validated taxonomy, score/rationale consistency, hard-fail/disposition consistency and exact blob/tree identity, then adjudicated conflicts (see reconciliation_overrides). Nothing executed, installed or fetched from candidates.
macro_findings: Every install-pointer card in Templates & Workflows (234) and Data Extraction & Transformation (209) was read in full and individually graded; all single-file auto-extracted README pointers.

107 capability-content mismatches: synthetic wrappers over Apache monorepos (dbt, Tika, Kafka, Airflow, Spark, Avro, Camel), pandas/parquet/jq/graphql-js/kafkajs wrappers, six terraform-module-* cards over hashicorp/terraform, ten cookiecutter variants, and cards whose install lines belong to a different tool (qsv cards installing zipsign, a Postgres MCP card with a golangci-lint line, an XSLT 3.0 card over lxml).
39 misattributions, chiefly the Apache Software Foundation, dbt Labs or Salesforce credited for synthetic or community wrappers.

37 cards advertise consequential operations without a gate (Salesforce bulk loads, schema-registry registration, Terraform apply, Stripe subscription portals, DigitalOcean droplet management, Cloudflare Workers deploys, n8n automations, Backstage changes, data publishing); 13 send private documents, resumes or workspace data to hosted extraction/LLM services (documind, zerox, paperless-gpt, LlamaCloud, Jina Reader, Resume Matcher and others).

One card prints an upstream example API key in a docker command (Typesense); it is flagged literal-credential and the key is redacted in this repository record. Five remote-code installs (e.g. curl ... | node, curl | bash) and two remote-instruction cards (fetch-and-follow manifests or llms.txt) were flagged.

Four REFERENCE-ONLY: GridCraft live-spreadsheet co-editing and OfficeIMO iWork conversion (pinned versions/commits, scoped access), workkit spec-build-review-ship pipeline (status-label gates, blind verifier, no commits before tests pass) and the job-iteration Rails resumable-jobs integration recipe.
